We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the forward reaction described: aromatic amine attacks electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, then collapse to expel Cl- and base deprotonates N-H to give sulfonamide. So functional group formed: sulfonamide (N-S bond). Broken bond: S-Cl bond.

We need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_formed includes "sulfonamide"? Not sure list. Might be "sulfonamide". Also broken bond S-Cl. So we can use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_formed ["sulfonamide"] and bonds_broken ["S-Cl"] maybe format "6-6"? Not sure. The tool expects bond types like "6-6" (atomic numbers). S is atomic number 16, Cl is 17. So bond broken "16-17". Use that.

Let's try search_template_catalog_by_criteria with molecule SMILES given, functional_groups_formed ["sulfonamide"], bonds_broken ["16-17"], limit maybe 5.
